world_and_protocol.deployment: Stable and reversal share input and all exogenous draws. The clean and noisy taste signs invert together at reversal_at_zero_based. The policy sees only the actual taste.
world_and_protocol.disabled: Blocks physical graph writes and preserves recurrent sensing of the actual disabled receipt.
world_and_protocol.yoked: All own-sensing arms are also deployed with the native yoked pre/post local sensing from a paired independently drawn donor world. Both lanes start at the same checkpoint. Only the primary world's outcomes are scored, with its original tape and draws.
world_and_protocol.return: ABA and CBA use one odor bank in the first phase, opposite hidden taste assignments, and the same exogenous draws. B uses new odors and is shared exactly across histories. A return uses the first A assignments on new presentations and is shared exactly. B_only starts at the same cold checkpoint and skips the first phase.
world_and_protocol.return_silent: Serial return controls suppress A taste and physical writes across the short prefix.
world_and_protocol.return_pre_feedback: Each early A motor sample forks from the same unmodified post-B state, with no contacts, taste or edits from earlier A probes.
world_and_protocol.transplant: After B, copy only the writer-receiver weight/support rows and writer biases into the same cold checkpoint. Checkpoint_writer uses the trained checkpoint as donor and its matched step-0 cold body as recipient. Donor activity is never copied. Disconnected grafts fall back to the recipient and remain identifiable in valid.
world_and_protocol.fork: At predetermined contacts of a live deployment, force or suppress the same proposal. Both branches sample their future decisions with identical exogenous draws and continue normal writes. Fork_holdout uses wholly independent worlds and a different slip rate. Fork_validation uses independently sampled worlds with the training contact count, two-cue stimulus distribution, layout mix and slip rate.
world_and_protocol.statistics: Score whole worlds within birth, then average births with equal weight. The paired hierarchical bootstrap resamples births and worlds within each resampled birth; intervals are pointwise. Calibration fits no model to holdout: zero effect and the constant mean of the corresponding deployment-fork split are comparators.

arrays.tape: [world, contact, ...]. Draw order is address, operation, motor, gate. Truth/outcome are the clean/noisy right-side taste signs.
arrays.deployment: [world, contact, ...], actual signed side, delivered taste, correctness, one-step p_correct, writer address/op, accepted/applied/status and predicted/actual effects.
arrays.return: [world, contact, ...]. ABA/CBA have three contiguous phase_contacts segments, B_only has two. The final phase is always A return.
arrays.transplant: [world, A-return contact, ...]; valid and writer distances are [world]. Checkpoint_writer score trajectories use the deployment contact axis.
arrays.fork: [world, fork contact, ...]. The time vector is zero-based. Future side/truth/action_changed arrays have an additional horizon axis. Targets are horizon mean take-minus-skip in positive delivered taste/clean correctness, or their per-branch sigmoid probabilities.
